// Records what sentry-go sends: error, message, transaction with spans, logs.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/getsentry/sentry-go"
)

type OrderError struct{ ID int }

func (e *OrderError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("order %d not found", e.ID) }

func loadOrder(id int) error { return fmt.Errorf("load order: %w", &OrderError{ID: id}) }

func main() {
	err := sentry.Init(sentry.ClientOptions{
		Dsn: "http://publickey@127.0.0.1:18490/42", Release: "shop@1.2.3", Environment: "staging",
		ServerName: "go-01", EnableTracing: true, TracesSampleRate: 1.0, SendDefaultPII: true,
		AttachStacktrace: true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	sentry.ConfigureScope(func(s *sentry.Scope) {
		s.SetUser(sentry.User{ID: "7", Email: "dev@example.com"})
		s.SetTag("feature", "checkout")
		s.AddBreadcrumb(&sentry.Breadcrumb{Category: "cart", Message: "added item 5", Level: sentry.LevelInfo}, 10)
	})
	if err := loadOrder(15); err != nil {
		var oe *OrderError
		_ = errors.As(err, &oe)
		sentry.CaptureException(err)
	}
	sentry.CaptureMessage("Payment gateway slow")

	ctx := context.Background()
	tx := sentry.StartTransaction(ctx, "GET /orders", sentry.WithOpName("http.server"))
	db := tx.StartChild("db.query", sentry.WithDescription("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = $1"))
	db.SetData("db.system", "postgresql")
	time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	db.Finish()
	hs := tx.StartChild("http.client", sentry.WithDescription("GET http://127.0.0.1:18490/health"))
	if resp, err := http.Get("http://127.0.0.1:18490/health"); err == nil {
		resp.Body.Close()
	}
	hs.Finish()
	tx.Finish()

	logger := sentry.NewLogger(ctx)
	logger.Info().String("cart_items", "3").Emitf("User %s opened cart", "7")
	logger.Error().String("sku", "A-1").Emit("Stock sync failed")

	sentry.Flush(5 * time.Second)
}
